title: LRU Cache
statement:
Design a data structure that follows the constraints of a Least Recently Used (LRU) cache.

Implement the LRUCache functionality:
- Initialize the LRU cache with positive size `capacity`.
- `1 key value` (put): Update the value of the key if the key exists. Otherwise, add the key-value pair to the cache. If the number of keys exceeds the capacity from this operation, evict the least recently used key.
- `2 key` (get): Print the value of the key if it exists, otherwise print `-1`.

The functions get and put must each run in O(1) average time complexity. Use a doubly linked list and a hash map.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers `capacity` and `Q` (number of operations).
Next Q lines: operations either `1 key value` or `2 key`.
outputFormat: For every `2` operation, print the resulting value on a new line.

examples.explanation:
Cache size 2. 
put(1,1), put(2,2). 
get(1) -> 1, marks 1 as most recent. 
put(3,3) -> evicts 2. 
get(2) -> -1. 
put(4,4) -> evicts 1. 
get(1) -> -1. 
get(3) -> 3.
